turns.text: I ordered a custom print of the house where I grew up. It arrived Monday and I'd like to return it.

Îmi pare rău să aud că ați primit un produs nepotrivit. Pentru a verifica returul, am nevoie de numărul comenzii (formatul SC- și patru cifre) și de adresa de e-mail cu care ați plasat comanda. / I'm sorry to hear that. To check the return, I need your order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email address the order was placed with.
That's SC-2214. The checkout email was rowan.bellwick@example.com.

Thank you, I've found order SC-2214. It is a custom commissioned print, "The House Behind the Mulberry Gate" (50x70 cm), so I can't accept a return for it under our policy. Our standard 14-day return applies only to catalogue prints. If the print arrived damaged or not as described, please tell me what is wrong and I can file a damage claim for staff to review.

items.title: The House Behind the Mulberry Gate

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.
